name: Freshmen: Physical Education
source:
Connor Brandt is newly out and on his own for the first time at the College for the 21st Century Arts, a multi-discipline arts school in the big city.

An aspiring writer, Connor is given a semester-long assignment to write all about his experiences with sex and sexuality. One problem: Connor's never been with anyone before.

Luckily, there are hot and interesting dudes everywhere on campus. Some are only in it for the sex—but others want something more. Connor has [i]a lot[/i] to learn before he can finish his assignment. Which guys will you choose to give Connor his physical education?

[From [url=https://freshmenvn.itch.io/freshmen-physical-education]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
康纳·布兰特刚刚出柜，如今来到大城市的二十一世纪艺术学院求学，第一次开始独立生活。这所艺术院校开设了多个学科。

立志成为作家的康纳接到了一份贯穿整个学期的作业：写下自己在性与性取向方面的种种经历。问题在于，他还从未与任何人有过亲密经验。

好在校园里到处都是迷人又有趣的男生。有些人只想上床，另一些人却期待更深的关系。要完成作业，康纳还有[i]太多东西[/i]需要学习。你会选择让哪些男生来给康纳上这堂身体教育课？

[摘自[url=https://freshmenvn.itch.io/freshmen-physical-education]itch.io[/url]]
